privacy.headerSubtitle: Transparency in data management, encryption security, and information retention of Kasir Warung
privacy.applicableTo: Applicable to Tenants, Cashier Staff, & Administrators
privacy.section1Subtitle: Used exclusively for sign-in (login) and account identity verification
privacy.section1Intro: We collect data including User Name and Email Address when you register a store (tenant) account or when cashier staff members are added to the system:
privacy.section1Point1Desc: Email is used as the primary identifier to log into the application.
privacy.section1Point2Desc: Email is used to send tenant registration verification links, store reactivation confirmations, and important security alerts.
privacy.section1Point3: We do not share, sell, or transfer your email address and name to any third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section2Subtitle: High-grade password protection with zero plain-text storage
privacy.section2HashDesc: Your password is encrypted and stored using the bcrypt hashing algorithm (with adaptive salt rounds). Neither the system nor developers ever store or have access to your plain-text password.
privacy.section2Detail: Even in the event of an unauthorized database inspection attempt, your password remains completely protected because one-way cryptographic hashing cannot be reversed into plain text. Every login authentication is performed through rigorous mathematical bcrypt hash matching.
privacy.section3Title: 3. Browser Data for Security & Fraud Prevention
privacy.section3Subtitle: Technical browser telemetry recorded to prevent unauthorized access
privacy.section3Intro: When you access or log in to the application, the system automatically records technical metadata:
privacy.section3Card1Desc: Browser type (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), version, and operating system utilized to access the application.
privacy.section3Card2Desc: Detect concurrent active sessions, protect against session hijacking attacks, and shield stores from suspicious activities.
privacy.section4Subtitle: Stored for product catalog operations and daily cashier POS transactions
privacy.section4Intro: Catalog data you input — including product names, barcodes/SKUs, product categories, cost prices, selling prices, and inventory stock counts — is securely stored in isolated tenant databases.
privacy.section4Desc: This data strictly belongs to your store tenant and is used solely to power Point of Sale (POS) cashier capabilities, barcode scanning lookups, and order total computations at your store.
privacy.section5Title: 5. Sales History & Login History (3-Month Retention & Download Feature)
privacy.section5Subtitle: Transparent retention policy, data export rights, and automated pruning
privacy.section5SalesDesc: Used for sales performance analytics, daily/monthly revenue accounting reports, and store bookkeeping.
privacy.section5SalesDownloadDesc: You can download complete sales transaction summaries at any time in archive format for your independent financial reporting.
privacy.section5AutoDelete: Stored for 3 months; automatically and permanently purged from the system after 3 months.
privacy.section5LoginDesc: Logged for system security to track user session history, IP addresses, client browsers, and account access timestamps.
privacy.section5LoginDownloadDesc: Store owners and platform administrators can download login history logs for periodic audits and account integrity checks.
privacy.section5CycleNoticeDesc: To preserve high system performance and adhere to data minimization principles, the system performs scheduled purges of sales records and login logs that exceed 3 months. We advise users to export monthly summaries before the 3-month window lapses.
privacy.section6Subtitle: Contact us for any privacy questions, feedback, or personal data rights requests
privacy.section6Intro: This application is engineered and maintained by Ferry Linton Hutapea. If you have questions regarding this privacy policy, data export requests, or account deactivation, you can directly reach out to:
